# Information display controls

Labels, images, progress and review cards.

(api-gui-forms-label)=
## Label

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/controls/label/label.hpp>
class Label : public Control
```

Label is a noninteractive retained text primitive with inherited typography roles, explicit font/color overrides, horizontal and vertical alignment, word wrapping, bounded line count, line spacing, mnemonics, and static-text semantics.

Status: stable. WinForms counterpart: `Label`.

- Text, horizontal and vertical alignment, wrapping, bounded line count, and line spacing are retained; `text_changed` is synchronous outside an initialization transaction.
- `TextStyleRole` selects inherited body, control, caption, heading, title, or monospace typography from the active theme. Font and foreground are independently overridable; `clear_font()` and `clear_foreground()` restore theme authority.
- `use_mnemonic` applies the portable ampersand contract to measure, paint, semantic text, and next-selectable-control focus. The label does not intercept hit testing.

| --- | --- |
| `explicit Label(StableId stable_id, std::string text = {})` | Constructs retained text and reflected Text, Font, ForeColor, and MaximumLines properties. |
| `const std::string& text() const noexcept` | Returns the authored UTF-8 text including any mnemonic marker. |
| `virtual void set_text(std::string text)` | Commits text, publishes text_changed, and avoids ancestor layout work for fixed-size telemetry labels. |
| `FontSpec font() const noexcept` | Resolves an explicit font or the active Theme typography token selected by text_style_role. |

(api-gui-forms-picturebox)=
## PictureBox

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/controls/panel/picture_box/picture_box.hpp>
class PictureBox : public Panel
```

PictureBox is a noninteractive Panel image presenter over Window-owned generational resources, with five canonical sizing modes, bounded opacity, inspectable image geometry, and image semantics.

Status: stable. WinForms counterpart: `PictureBox`.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `explicit PictureBox(StableId stable_id)` | Constructs a clipped image surface and registers its reflected SizeMode property schema. |
| `ImageId image() const noexcept` | Returns the retained generational ImageId, which may be empty or stale. |
| `void set_image(ImageId image)` | Validates Window ownership when attached, selects the resource, and publishes image_changed after invalidation. |
| `void clear_image()` | Routes through set_image with an empty ImageId so clearing obeys the same event order. |
| `bool has_valid_image() const noexcept` | Reports whether the current ImageId resolves in the attached Window registry. |
| `Size image_size() const noexcept` | Returns current resource pixel dimensions in logical Size form, or an empty size when unavailable. |
| `PictureBoxSizeMode size_mode() const noexcept` | Returns normal, stretch, auto-size, centered, or aspect-preserving zoom policy. |
| `void set_size_mode(PictureBoxSizeMode mode)` | Validates the closed sizing vocabulary and updates measurement/paint/property state atomically. |
| `double image_opacity() const noexcept` | Returns the retained image alpha multiplier. |
| `void set_image_opacity(double opacity)` | Accepts only finite values from zero through one and invalidates painting. |
| `Rect image_bounds() const noexcept` | Computes the local destination rectangle from content bounds, source dimensions, and size mode. |
| `Event<ImageId>& image_changed() noexcept` | Returns the event published after a complete image selection change. |
| `Size measure(Size available) override` | Uses source dimensions for auto-size and otherwise preserves ordinary Panel sizing constraints. |
| `void on_paint(Painter& painter, Rect local_damage) override` | Paints the Panel first, clips to content, and records the live image at resolved bounds and opacity. |
| `bool hit_test_local(Point local_point) const override` | Keeps PictureBox noninteractive so it does not intercept its container. |
| `SemanticDescriptor semantic_descriptor() const override` | Projects an image role, authored accessible text, and the current resource identity without exposing pixels. |

(api-gui-forms-progressbar)=
## ProgressBar

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/controls/range_control/progress_bar/progress_bar.hpp>
class ProgressBar : public RangeControl
```

ProgressBar is a noninteractive RangeControl visualization with continuous, segmented, and marquee modes; optional overlays and stripes; centralized motion-policy resolution; retained frame scheduling; deterministic phase; reduced-motion behavior; and progress semantics.

Status: stable. WinForms counterpart: `ProgressBar`.

- Noninteractive. Continuous, segmented, and marquee modes plus optional overlays and stripes are public library styles.
- Motion is resolved through one centralized policy; the control becomes scheduler-quiescent when paused, disabled, or effectively hidden, and reduced motion stays visibly animated at the calmer public cadence.
- Nonfocusable and hit-test transparent; publishes numeric or busy semantics.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `explicit ProgressBar(StableId stable_id)` | Constructs a non-focusable, non-hit-testable range visualization with progress semantics. |
| `ProgressBarVisualStyle visual_style() const noexcept` | Returns continuous, segmented, or marquee presentation. |
| `void set_visual_style(ProgressBarVisualStyle style)` | Validates style, updates animation registration, and invalidates size, paint, and semantics. |
| `ProgressBarOverlayStyle overlay_style() const noexcept` | Returns none, solid, or striped overlay policy. |
| `void set_overlay_style(ProgressBarOverlayStyle style)` | Validates overlay vocabulary and invalidates painting. |
| `double stripe_width() const noexcept` | Returns the positive logical stripe width used by compatibility overlay painting. |
| `void set_stripe_width(double width)` | Accepts a finite bounded positive width and synchronizes animation appearance. |
| `const ProgressBarAnimationAppearance& animation_appearance() const noexcept` | Returns stripe width, gap, angle, and opacity as one value. |
| `void set_animation_appearance(ProgressBarAnimationAppearance appearance)` | Validates all animation geometry/opacity fields and commits them atomically. |
| `bool animation_enabled() const noexcept` | Reports caller intent to animate marquee or striped presentation. |
| `void set_animation_enabled(bool enabled)` | Toggles animation intent and reconciles Window frame registration. |
| `bool animation_paused() const noexcept` | Reports whether application policy currently freezes phase. |
| `void set_animation_paused(bool paused)` | Toggles pause state without discarding deterministic phase. |
| `bool reduced_motion() const noexcept` | Reports the local compatibility override for reduced motion. |
| `void set_reduced_motion(bool reduced)` | Toggles the local override and reconciles effective animation registration. |
| `void set_motion_policy(bool paused, bool reduced_motion)` | Installs or clears an explicit policy override instead of inheriting the Window policy. |
| `void set_motion_policy(MotionPolicy policy)` | Installs or clears an explicit policy override instead of inheriting the Window policy. |
| `MotionPolicy motion_policy() const noexcept` | Returns the optional caller-authored motion-policy override. |
| `MotionPolicy effective_motion_policy() const noexcept` | Resolves local compatibility state, explicit override, and attached Window policy into one behavior. |
| `FrameInterval animation_period() const noexcept` | Returns the positive duration of one animation cycle. |
| `void set_animation_period(FrameInterval period)` | Accepts a positive duration and preserves phase continuity. |
| `double animation_phase() const noexcept` | Returns the normalized retained phase used for deterministic rendering and tests. |
| `Size measure(Size available) override` | Provides stable progress-track desired thickness independent of phase. |
| `void on_paint(Painter& painter, Rect local_damage) override` | Records the selected track/fill/segment/marquee/overlay presentation from current range and phase. |
| `void on_frame(FrameTime now) override` | Advances phase from frame time under effective motion policy and invalidates only when pixels change. |
| `bool hit_test_local(Point local_point) const override` | Always declines input because progress is informational. |
| `SemanticDescriptor semantic_descriptor() const override` | Projects a progress role with numeric range/value and indeterminate state where applicable. |

(api-gui-forms-reviewcard)=
## ReviewCard

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/controls/panel/card/review_card/review_card.hpp>
class ReviewCard final : public Card
```

ReviewCard is a typed Card specialization that owns title, summary, and verdict Labels and atomically projects a bounded UTF-8 ReviewRecord into text, visual status, and semantics.

Status: stable. No WinForms counterpart.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `explicit ReviewCard(StableId stable_id)` | Constructs the three retained Label roles with theme-aware heading, body, and caption policies; attachment remains lazy and idempotent. |
| `void initialize_control_tree()` | Attaches the three owned Labels to Card roles exactly once, allowing construction before shared ownership is established. |
| `const ReviewRecord& record() const noexcept` | Returns the committed typed ReviewRecord. |
| `void set_record(ReviewRecord record)` | Validates identity, UTF-8, bounded text sizes, and disposition before any mutation; then updates all labels, accessibility text, status, and publishes one record_changed event. |
| `std::shared_ptr<Label> title_label() const noexcept` | Returns the owned header Label for ordinary Label-level customization. |
| `std::shared_ptr<Label> summary_label() const noexcept` | Returns the owned wrapping body Label for ordinary Label-level customization. |
| `std::shared_ptr<Label> verdict_label() const noexcept` | Returns the owned footer Label for ordinary Label-level customization. |
| `Event<const ReviewRecord&>& record_changed() noexcept` | Returns the event published after the complete record projection commits. |
| `Size measure(Size available) override` | Ensures the internal tree exists, then uses Card's section measurement law. |
| `void arrange(Rect final_bounds) override` | Ensures the internal tree exists, then uses Card's section arrangement law. |
| `SemanticDescriptor semantic_descriptor() const override` | Projects title, summary, verdict, pending, and rejected state from the same committed record used by the visible Labels. |

**Data members**

```cpp
static constexpr bool initialize_tree_after_construction = true;
```
